name: the people of the Hill
description: Everyone who works between the White House and the Capitol.

name: the Drump administration
description: The President and the people who work for him in the White House.
norms: loyalty to the President above all

name: the Senate
description: The senators, with the Vice President as their presiding officer.
norms: a senator's word on a vote is binding
courtesy on the floor, knives in the corridor

name: the Harvest Party
description: The opposition, strong in farm country.

name: the kitchen folk
description: The two cooks who feed the Hill, and know everything said over their counters.

name: the Gulf Petro friends
description: Those who quietly take money from the Gulf Petro oil men.
purpose: keep oil dear and the money coming
norms: never say the name in public
